chapter: Callers: Papa John Joseph to Congo Square
title: Taping Tulane's records and an FM show
summary: A caller asks about copying records at Tulane and a possible FM jazz show; Allen cites copyright.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Copyright notices and interview title pages

blocks.x: Not only that, it's all being taped. Good morning. You're on the air.

Hello, uh, Joe. I'd like to ask Mr. Allen, this may have been mentioned earlier. I didn't tune in until about 9, 15 or so. But I'd like to ask him if it's possible for private collectors to tape any of the rare, uh, records which he has at Tulane University.

Good question. I think lots of people have that in their minds now. Dick Allen. Well, uh, unfortunately, copyright laws, uh, prevent things like that. But, uh, many of the things that we have are commercially available. And we're not, uh, trying to infringe on, uh, the rights of a commercial record company. That would be wrong. Uh, it's just about the same price it ends up by the time you get a decent tape recording and you go out and buy the records. So I'll be glad to let you know what is available to have catalogs of these companies. Right.

Well, may I ask this then? Of course, uh, uh, so many others do this anyhow. Uh, have there ever been any plans for you to do, uh, any sort of a show on FM radio? And I'm not knocking Joe's show by any means. I'm taping this one too. But, uh, at the risk of, uh, violating the copyright.
Yeah, let me advise you that you can't replay it at a, at a commercial. At a commercial price. Okay. I'm talking about Joe's show. Yeah, yeah, I know. I'm, I'm being facetious. Go ahead.

But, uh, I'm wondering if, uh, Tulane or some other group, maybe the Jazz Club would sponsor an FM, uh, broadcast where, uh, the, uh, quality of tape would be, uh, would approach the original records which are put on.

Um, well, uh, I would like to do that, of course, uh, sometime. But so far, I haven't had to do much of that lately. There's only so much time in a week. Yeah. I have been involved in radio and television many, many times. Maybe Joe will give me a nice off-off.
Too bad they don't put, put it out.
